description: Reads the app in this workspace (never changes a file) and reports what a design for it should reuse: framework and styling, its tokens with the file and line each comes from (Tailwind theme, CSS variables including dark and [data-theme] blocks, MUI theme), its light and dark themes, its exported components with their variant props (most imported first), and its screens (Next.js, Expo Router and React Router routes). Use it before designing a screen, flow or redesign for an app that already exists, then show the user what was found. With name (after the user agrees), it also returns a DESIGN.md, tokens.css and components.json to save as a design system, so briefs list the app's components and the check flags hard-coded and undefined tokens. When a design system was already saved from the same app, it reports what changed since. Bounded to 2,000 files and 1 MB; never reads .env files.

name.description: A name for the design system to save from the app, e.g. "Acme app". Only after the user agrees to save one.

root.description: Workspace-relative folder of the app, for a monorepo (default the workspace root).

name: scan_open_design_app
title: Scan the app
